whatItIs: catalyst is an open-source project in the general-purpose sdks category. It is maintained by PennyLaneAI and primarily looks like a Python codebase.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches general-purpose sdks workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes:

Catalyst is an experimental package that enables just-in-time (JIT) compilation of hybrid quantum-classical programs.
whoItsFor: Developers who want a broad entry point for building circuits, experimenting with algorithms, and integrating quantum workflows into larger applications.
whatYouCanBuild: Prototype end-to-end circuit workflows without committing to a niche backend too early.
